rows.grounds: object of the act of worship; compound denoting flowers cupped in the hands as an offering
absolutive indicating the preparatory act preceding worship
instrument specifying the mantra appropriate to the worship; mantra syllables are ritual formulae, not translated

items.question: What offering and recitation are required to perform proper worship of the visualized deity?
premises: A handful of flowers is taken as the offering.
The act of worship is performed with the respective mantra.
The worship follows the visualization of the fully adorned deity.
items.inference: Proper worship of the visualized deity consists in offering flowers accompanied by the appropriate mantra.
uncertainties: prati+mantreṇa may indicate a mantra specific to each element or the mantra corresponding to the deity; rendered as 'respective mantra'.
items.plain_english: Having taken a handful of flowers, one should worship with the respective mantra.
